create.name: Norma and Nisha Burton
create.bio:
Norma J. Burton and her daughter Nisha Burton teach lucid dreaming together under the name Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living. Norma is a Jungian-trained psychologist, ordained minister and hospice chaplain who completed a master of divinity in Berkeley and spent around twenty-five years learning from Indigenous shamanic elders; earlier in her career she was a senior minister in Ashland, Oregon. Nisha brings more than a decade of her own lucid dreaming practice and a background in virtual reality and filmmaking, which shapes the visual, hands-on side of their teaching.

Their signature approach, which they call psychonavigation, treats dreaming, drumming journeys and waking mindfulness as linked ways of travelling between states of awareness, with shadow work running through all of it. They offer self-paced online courses, a free five-day dream challenge and a free iPhone dream journal app, post short teaching videos on YouTube, and lead a week-long residential programme at Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York. Together they wrote Navigating Liminal Realms and created the Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living oracle deck, and both titles have been published in several languages.

books.title: Navigating Liminal Realms: Psychonavigation Skills for Lucid Dreaming, Trance Journeys, and Altered States
books.author: Norma J. Burton, Nisha Burton
books.description: A practical handbook for moving consciously through different states of awareness, from lucid dreams to drum-led trance journeys and other altered states. It sets out their psychonavigation method step by step, with exercises, journalling prompts and attention to staying grounded.

books.title: Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living: Your Oracle and Guide to Mastering the Dreamscape
books.author: Nisha Burton, Norma J. Burton
books.description: A boxed set of 44 illustrated cards with a 200-page guidebook, with a foreword by Philip Carr-Gomm. The cards can be drawn for everyday questions or used to set intentions before sleep, and the guidebook teaches lucid dreaming technique alongside them.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living
courses.description: A six-day residential at Omega's Rhinebeck campus mixing short lectures with guided drumming journeys, meditation, dream journalling, drawing and group sharing. Participants practise lucid dreaming techniques each night and leave with daily habits for dream recall and awareness; all levels are welcome.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living Master Class
courses.description: Their main self-paced course, with more than five hours of video across modules on remembering dreams, setting intent, checking whether you are dreaming, meeting the shadow and taking more advanced journeys. Guided audio and workbooks are included, with lifetime access.

courses.title: Animal Instincts: Drumming Journeys for Inner Guidance
courses.description: A recorded course in shamanic drumming journeys, spread over 32 lessons in four modules, each with its own drumming track. It pairs the journeys with shadow work and exercises for telling genuine inner guidance apart from mental chatter, and includes a private community.

courses.title: Purpose Mapping With Lucid Dreaming
courses.description: An hour-long recorded masterclass with workbook lessons on catching and decoding dream symbols and turning what emerges into a clearer sense of direction. A bonus guided meditation is included.

free_resources.title: Quick Lucid Dreaming Guided Meditation - Lucid Dream Tonight!
free_resources.description: An eleven-minute guided meditation for bedtime that settles the body and sets a clear intention to notice when you are dreaming. Free on their YouTube channel.

free_resources.title: Find Your Life Purpose With This Dream Meditation
free_resources.description: A guided meditation of about fourteen minutes that invites the dreaming mind to offer images about your direction in life, to be noted down on waking.

free_resources.title: The 5-Day Dream Intelligence Challenge
free_resources.description: A free email course of five short daily lessons, about ten minutes each, covering dream recall, asking a question before sleep, first steps in lucid dreaming and mapping dream themes onto waking life.

free_resources.title: Lucid Living app
free_resources.description: Their free iPhone app for logging and tagging dreams, spotting recurring dream signs, keeping a daytime awareness journal and listening to guided lucid dreaming and drumming audio.

flags: One listing for a mother and daughter who teach together: named 'Norma and Nisha Burton' (Omega lists Norma first and the joint workshop names both); slug norma-and-nisha-burton. Nisha also has her own Omega page (https://www.eomega.org/people/nisha-burton).

Photos are separate single headshots of each woman (Norma from Omega; Nisha from Omega and their site), since no single photo shows 'the listing'; the site headshot is taken to be Nisha from the face match. A human may prefer only one image.

Norma's own site (normaburton.com) and their Journey to Completion programme are framed as trauma healing and coaching, so they are left out; the lucid dreaming work is the basis of this listing, but a human may want to judge the therapy share.
Email is the brand inbox for Lucid Dreaming, Lucid Living (Lucid Living Inc.), published on the contact page and in every footer.
Course prices are shown as reduced launch prices on sales pages; both the current and 'normal' prices are noted.
YouTube channel videos are mostly presented by Nisha; view counts were not available, so the newest evergreen teaching videos were chosen rather than the most viewed.
entity_type is set to 'individual' although the listing covers two people; a human may prefer another type if one exists for duos.
